summary: Tested Profile Settings (name, email preferences, password) and Share Tracking end to end. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass (tests/test_lords_gym_account_invites.py). Covered: PUT /account persists and trims the name; empty and whitespace-only names give 422; email can't be changed. Password change: a wrong or empty current password gives 400, a short new password gives 422. A successful change keeps the current session, gives old cookies 401 on /me and /refresh, makes the old password fail and the new one work. A Google-only user can set a password with no current password. share-events: 401 when logged out, 422 for a bad source/channel; counts are right. /account/invites and /admin/invites: 403 for non-admins, correct spread/train/shares/joined values, sorted by joined, and a non-ObjectId referred_by doesn't crash. The cron opt-out filters were checked by running run_day2_reminders/run_journey_nudges in a separate temporary DB with the email senders stubbed. Opted-out users are skipped; legacy users with no field still get emails. Frontend: everything requested passes. Logged out, /account redirects to login and returns to /account after sign-in. nav-account works. The invites summary went from 'You've invited 0 friends, 1 joined' to '3 friends, 1 joined' after shares. Name and switch changes survive a reload. Toasts showed for an empty name, wrong password, mismatched passwords and success. The Google-only user saw 'Set a Password' with no current-password field, then 'Change Password' after setting one. Spread the Word Email/SMS/Copy each POST source=spread, and the message, mailto link and clipboard all contain /book?ref=<id>. The Train Someone Next modal (seeded user with all 7 done) Copy/SMS/Email POST source=train. /book?ref=X sets the join link to /register?ref=X and stores lg-ref. A plain /register then sent referred_by=X, and joined went up to 2. /admin/invites shows the table, the empty state and totals; a non-admin is redirected to /dashboard and the link is hidden. The mobile Account page has no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: Brevo race when marketing is toggled quickly. The create_contact (on) and remove_from_list (off) background tasks can run out of order if two saves land within about a second. Seen in the pytest run: remove returned 400 'Contact ... does not exist', then create returned 201. The DB then says opted out while the contact stays on Brevo list 3. Sequential saves with a gap work (both 201). Fix: run the Brevo sync from the current DB state, e.g. a background task that re-reads marketing_opt_in before calling Brevo, or await the call inline.
No rate limit or dedupe, so a reader can inflate their 'invited' count without limit (and the admin leaderboard with it). Consider a per-user, per-minute cap.

ui_bugs.issue: A non-admin still fires GET /admin/invites before <Navigate> redirects. The 403 is an unhandled promise rejection ('Request failed with status code 403' in the console). Skip the fetch when !user.is_admin, or add .catch.
api.get('/account/invites') has no .catch. On failure the panel stays hidden and the rejection is unhandled.

issues: The unchecked Switch track is dark grey on a near-black surface, so the off state is hard to see (low contrast). Give the off track a lighter fill or border, e.g. data-[state=unchecked]:bg-zinc-600.
The copy reads 'You've invited 1 friend' when 1 share happened. Wording is fine, but it counts share clicks, not people.

action_items: (Minor) PUT /account: make the Brevo add/remove sync order-safe (re-read the DB state in the task, or await it inline)
(Minor) AdminInvites: don't call /admin/invites for non-admins, or catch the 403; add .catch to InvitesPanel
(Minor) Raise the contrast of the unchecked Switch on the Account page

(Important, test infra) /app/backend/tests/seed_rep7_users.py lists john.youell@newlifeokc.org in USERS, so running seed or clean DELETES the real owner account and its progress. Remove that entry and seed a TEST_ admin via ADMIN_EMAILS instead. It was NOT run in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: The cron queries correctly use reminders_opt_in {$ne: False}, so legacy users with no field still get reminders (verified).
referred_by accepts any string up to 64 characters. It is never checked against a real user, and admin_invites drops non-ObjectId or unknown ids (no crash). Acceptable.
localStorage lg-ref is never cleared after a successful register, so later signups on the same device are credited to the same referrer. Consider removing it after register or a Google sign-up.
server.py is now 1017 lines (guideline 700). Split it into account/admin/assessment route modules.
seed_data_creation: Seeded test_inv_* and test_accui_* @example.com users (password, Google-only, a referred friend, a user with all 7 assessments done, and test_inv_admin@example.com) directly in Mongo. One UI register (test_accui_referred@example.com) sent a real Brevo welcome email. Marketing toggles made Brevo contact add/remove calls for @example.com only. All TEST users, share_events, progress and login_attempts were removed, and the temporary DB tmp_cron_test_db was dropped. ADMIN_EMAILS was temporarily set to include test_inv_admin@example.com, then restored to the original value and the backend restarted. The DB holds only john.youell@newlifeokc.org, which was untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_lords_gym_account_invites.py. The admin test needs test_inv_admin@example.com added to ADMIN_EMAILS (restart the backend, then revert). The cron test runs server functions in a subprocess with DB_NAME=tmp_cron_test_db and stubbed senders, so it is safe to run. For UI: 'python seed_account_ui.py seed' prints MAIN_ID and GOOGLE_TOKEN (add it as the access_token cookie to act as the Google-only user); run 'cleanup' afterwards. Do NOT run seed_rep7_users.py (it deletes john.youell).
